scripts.clean: node -e "try { require('node:fs').rmSync('release',{recursive:true,force:true}) } catch (e) { if (e.code === 'EPERM' || e.code === 'EBUSY') { console.error('release 目录被占用，请关闭正在运行的生活记录，并关闭资源管理器里打开的 release 文件夹后重试。'); process.exit(1) } throw e }"
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run clean && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
